definitions.gloss: person sensitive to the heat; someone who feels the heat easily
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who tends to feel hot more than others and is quick to seek cool air or remove layers.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}がりなので、{夏|なつ}はエアコンが{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Since I'm sensitive to heat, air conditioning is essential in summer.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}がりの{息子|むすこ}は、{真冬|まふゆ}でも{半袖|はんそで}で{出|で}かけようとする。
examples.english: My heat-sensitive son tries to go out in short sleeves even in the dead of winter.

notes:
Formed from {暑|あつ}い + がる (to show signs of) + い → り (nominalization). Describes a person who tends to feel hot more easily than others.

USAGE:
Functions as both a noun and a na-adjective:
- {暑|あつ}がりだ: I'm/he's sensitive to heat (noun + copula)
- {暑|あつ}がりな{人|ひと}: a heat-sensitive person (na-adjective)
- {暑|あつ}がりの{息子|むすこ}: my heat-sensitive son (noun + の)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暑|あつ}がりで{汗|あせ}っかき: sensitive to heat and sweats easily
- {暑|あつ}がりなので{薄着|うすぎ}: wears light clothing because of heat sensitivity

RELATED 〜がり WORDS:
- {寒|さむ}がり: person sensitive to cold (opposite)
- {怖|こわ}がり: scaredy-cat, timid person
- {恥|は}ずかしがり: shy person

The 〜がり pattern creates nouns/na-adjectives describing personality traits from adjectives: [adjective stem] + がり.
